enabled.description: Enable only after deployment and search credential approval

public_terms.description: Legacy reviewed scope only; ignored in general_public. Never put private facts here.

fetch_hosts.description: Legacy reviewed scope only; ignored in general_public. URL provenance and network safety always apply.

scope.description: general_public removes fixed topic/host allowlists; keeps current-input provenance, privacy, URL/DNS safety and shared quotas. Missing scope preserves legacy reviewed behavior.

daily_attempt_limit.description: Combined Search/Fetch daily attempt ceiling; engineering default pending approval, not a target frequency
